title: Compose templates still paste spec strings raw into YAML scalars: volumes (vol.name:vol.path), resources.memory and resources.cpu (inside single quotes), companion memory, spec.domain (traefik Host label; Spec does not validate it — only the apply dict validator does), and health.interval/timeout; the docker-image writer (deployer_ssh._generate_docker_compose) pastes memory and health interval raw. A quote, newline, " #" or ": " breaks or mangles compose (review B-1: interval "10s\n retries: 99" renders a duplicate retries: key that PyYAML accepts). Found by the W-ff313a14 design critique (Opus) and review pass 1 (slice B).
